metadata.title: I-AM-IS-I-AM Research Atlas
metadata.scope: Curated research navigation; not a complete chat archive, canonical status promotion or empirical confirmation.
metadata.coverage: Five candidate saved drafts inspected; 13 canonical registry records adapted; 15 historical/owner records, three present review records and three explanatory mathematical models.
limitations: No complete ChatGPT history/API/export was recovered.
File dates are not message dates; speaker and model identity are unknown unless explicitly sourced.
Private full texts and identifiers are retained outside the repository.

questions.text: Is the continuum static, generative, or a family of states, and what mathematical object represents it?
questions.text_ro: Continuumul este static, generativ sau o familie de stări, și ce obiect matematic îl reprezintă?

questions.text: Does projection mean a map, a slice, a coarse-graining, an embedding, or a physical process?
questions.text_ro: Proiecția înseamnă o aplicație, o secțiune, o descriere simplificată, o includere sau un proces fizic?

questions.text: If the proposed ground is timeless, what parameter describes folding and what would a folding speed mean?
questions.text_ro: Dacă fundamentul propus este atemporal, ce parametru descrie plierea și ce ar însemna viteza ei?

questions.text: What set and admissibility relation distinguish ontological totality from the access of a single observer?
questions.text_ro: Ce mulțime și ce relație de admisibilitate disting totalitatea ontologică de accesul unui singur observator?

questions.text: Which additional equations, boundary data and discriminating observations would connect local consistency to a physical theory?
questions.text_ro: Ce ecuații suplimentare, date la frontieră și observații discriminante ar lega consistența locală de o teorie fizică?
